findings.title: Materials' 65-point lens gap
findings.body: Materials sits at the 17th percentile on forward earnings but the 82nd on trailing, a 65-point split that is the widest in the table. The market is underwriting 113 percent earnings growth, which would be a dramatic reversal for a sector whose trailing multiple is already rich.

findings.title: Energy's cheap forward, rich trailing
findings.body: Energy's forward P/E of 11.76 is near the middle of its five-year range, yet its trailing multiple is at the 83rd percentile. The 60 percent implied earnings growth is the market's bet on a cyclical rebound, but the forward percentile has fallen 19 points in a month, suggesting that bet is fading.

findings.title: Consumer Staples' sudden re-rating
findings.body: Consumer Staples' forward percentile jumped 32 points in a week, the largest one-week move in the table, even as its trailing percentile sits at 77. The market is paying up for defensive earnings stability, but the 38 percent implied growth is a stretch for a sector that typically delivers single-digit expansion.
